$comment: v2 motion grammar. Elevates the strongest anti-patterns from penalized to blocker. Supersedes data/v3_2/motion_anti_ai_fingerprints.json in v5 gate decisions.
core_rule: motion has one legitimate job: to describe a relationship (orientation, hierarchy, continuity, feedback, or state). 'Feeling premium' is not a relationship.

families.note: a family, not the absence of one; long editorial pages default here
state activation, captions, secondary UI - not section entrances
display type where container shape is part of composition
editorial media, portfolio work, product hero
workhorse of product UI motion; never 'entering from nowhere'
objects with perceived mass; not cards or buttons
shared element or expand-collapse where continuity matters
when typography is the driver; change the type itself, not its container
only when the section is genuinely about progression
precise, small, local; never required for critical understanding
loading, saving, error; measured in ms

blockers.pattern: universal fade-up as page reveal system
blockers.detection: opacity 0->1 with translateY(20-40px) applied on more than one section
blockers.action: delete helper; animate at most one section with an appropriate grammar; leave others static

blockers.detection: delay: index * 0.1 or equivalent across the page
blockers.action: stagger by hierarchy or reading order, or delete the stagger

blockers.pattern: single easing token across UI, editorial, and object motion
blockers.detection: fewer than 3 distinct easing values across roles
blockers.action: define role-specific easing: ui, editorial, object

blockers.pattern: every section entering with the same grammar
blockers.detection: identical entrance recipe across sections A, B, C
blockers.action: the fingerprint is repetition; do not vary duration, vary whether motion is used at all

blockers.pattern: motion added to fix an empty-feeling composition
blockers.detection: sections with entrance animation but weak content density or hierarchy
blockers.action: fix the composition; motion cannot paper over composition problems

penalties: blur-in on entrance without focal-plane logic
long pinned sections for atmosphere rather than progression
scrollY * magic-number math scattered through components
final_test: turn off all motion; if the composition still communicates, motion was doing honest supporting work; if not, motion was carrying composition and composition must be fixed
